query: CREATE TABLE bench.hits_fixed AS bench.hits ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, UserID, EventTime, WatchID) SETTINGS fsync_after_insert = 1, auto_statistics_types = \'\', index_granularity = 8192

INSERT INTO bench.hits_fixed SELECT * FROM bench.hits SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_threads = 16, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 1073741824, max_insert_block_size = 10000000
EXCHANGE TABLES bench.hits AND bench.hits_fixed FORMAT Native
